% SlideMage template name: Conditional shape (test only)
% A TEST theme with the shape of an older project theme (no institution's colours): no modes, a
% setting inside \ifdefined ... \fi that the form must leave alone, a \colorlet for a code colour,
% indented lines, trailing comments, and project macros after the base. tests/test_theme_file.py
% reads and edits it.
\input{SlideMage_setup}

% Palette (official colours first).
\definecolor{c_primary_dark}{HTML}{3c3c3b} % official
\definecolor{c_primary_highlight}{HTML}{f39200} % official
\definecolor{c_primary_gray}{HTML}{878786} % official
\definecolor{c_primary_white}{HTML}{FFFFFF}
\definecolor{c_secondary_blue}{HTML}{003360} % official
\definecolor{c_tertiary_blue}{HTML}{8099B0} % derived (50% white-blend of c_secondary_blue)

\renewcommand{\SMInstituteLogoPath}{schemes/scheme_test/logo-cropped.pdf}
\setlength{\SMLogoHeight}{3ex}

\renewcommand{\SMTitleBoxColor}{c_secondary_blue}
\renewcommand{\SMTitleTextColor}{c_primary_white}

% White info block titles, only with a framework that has the hook.
\ifdefined\SMInfoBlockTitleTextColor
  \renewcommand{\SMInfoBlockTitleTextColor}{c_primary_white}
\fi

  \colorlet{SMCodeKeywordColor}{c_secondary_blue}   % indented on purpose
\definecolor{SMCodeCommentColor}{HTML}{5f5f5f}

\input{SlideMage_base}

\input{SlideMage_project_macros}
